title: cargo build fails: (StatusCode, serde_json::Value) has no into_response
evidence: src/models.rs:30 `(status, serde_json::json!({ "error": message })).into_response()` — error[E0599] no method named `into_response` for tuple `(StatusCode, JsonValue)`; the JSON error-response path does not compile. Reproduced with the run's own Cargo.toml+Cargo.lock (cargo build exit != 0).
suggestion: Wrap the body in axum::Json: `(status, Json(serde_json::json!({ "error": message }))).into_response()`

title: cargo build fails: axum::serve rejects Router<Arc<Mutex<..>>> (state not erased, serve not awaited)
evidence: src/main.rs:79-90 — `.with_state(state.clone())` is chained BEFORE `.route(...)`, so the Router keeps state type param and never becomes Router<()>; error[E0277] `Router<Arc<Mutex<Pool<Sqlite>>>>: Service<IncomingStream>` at src/main.rs:90. Also `axum::serve(listener, app);` is not `.await`ed.
suggestion: Move `.with_state(state)` to AFTER all `.route(...)` calls, and `axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();`

title: Stored scores.json reports test_coverage=1.0 / defect_rate=0.83, but the crate does not compile
evidence: scores.json: {"test_coverage": 1.0, "defect_rate": 0.83...} yet `cargo build` and `cargo test` both fail (2 errors) with the run's exact Cargo.lock. The recorded build+test pass is a false positive; no tests could have run.
suggestion: Re-score this run: the mechanical test/build gate did not reflect the actual (failing) compile. test_coverage should be 0.

title: No tests exist (spec requires >= 3 unit/integration tests)
evidence: No #[test]/#[tokio::test]/#[cfg(test)]/`mod tests` in src/ (grep empty); no tests/ dir; `grep -rin 'test|assert' src/` returns nothing across database.rs/main.rs/models.rs (291 LOC). Confirms first evaluator. Additionally the crate does not compile, so even 0 tests cannot run.
suggestion: Add >= 3 tests (e.g. #[tokio::test] hitting create/list/get) once the build is fixed.

title: No README.md with setup and run instructions
evidence: `find . -iname 'readme*'` (excluding target/) returns nothing; no README in run root or src/. Confirms first evaluator.
suggestion: Add README.md documenting `cargo run`, the endpoints, and the SQLite setup.

title: GET /books ?author= filter not wired to the HTTP layer
evidence: DB layer supports it (src/database.rs:33-57 get_all_books(author_filter)), but the handler src/main.rs:26-33 declares `author: Option<String>` as a bare argument, not an axum `Query<...>` extractor, so the ?author= query param is never parsed from the request (and this arg is itself part of why the handler/route types don't line up).
suggestion: Extract the filter via `Query(params): Query<HashMap<String,String>>` (or a typed struct) and pass params.get("author") to get_all_books.

title: GET /books/{id} returns 500 not 404 for a missing id
evidence: src/database.rs:59-68 get_book_by_id uses `.fetch_one` → sqlx::Error::RowNotFound on absent id → mapped by `#[from] sqlx::Error` (src/models.rs:7) to AppError::Database → 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (src/models.rs:20-23), whereas the spec wants 404.
suggestion: Use fetch_optional and return AppError::NotFound when None (as delete_book already does).
